support_claim: Commercial notes record that Oakfield Logistics GmbH rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH under unchanged HRB 88421 while CRM retained the old English-facing name, CRM row OAK-77 is named Oakfield Logistics, and billing invoices bill Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
justification: The packet links crm:OAK-77 to the pre-rebrand English-facing CRM name and documents that this legal counterparty is now Oakfield Logistik GmbH with the same registry number; billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH matches that current legal name, establishing identity rather than mere name compatibility.
